value.rationale: An established non-renewed Cox resetting model has measurable time dependence not determined by a simple stationary variance threshold. For low-rate exponent \(1<\alpha\le2\) the variance has a finite limit while integrated normalized correlations diverge, distinguishing static localization from temporal memory. Exact incomplete-gamma and logarithmic-lag profiles give natural, distribution-class-universal predictions for slow environmental relaxation. The exact exponent-two time-memory threshold and critical observation-time profile address a structural gap, not arbitrary parameter substitutions.
